content:
Maya (eng-ml): bringing up serpentine-embed-compact-v0.3 on staging. quick smoke shows wiki-holdout recall@10 = 0.68 vs prod-embed (v1.9) 0.74. UMAP clusters look more smeared too. anyone seen this pattern?

Ben (research): are you sure preprocessing/pooling is identical? avg pooling vs CLS differences bite often.

Maya (eng-ml): yes same tokenizer + avg pooling. eval command I used: 
```
python eval/recall.py --model serpentine-compact-v0.3 --dataset wiki-holdout --batch 64 --quant none --index-config index/hnsw_v1.json
```
Raw summary: 
```
N=10000 samples
Prod (v1.9): recall@1 0.51 recall@5 0.67 recall@10 0.74
Serpentine v0.3: recall@1 0.45 recall@5 0.61 recall@10 0.68
```

Juniper (evals): can you paste the HNSW/IVF params? index params and search nprobe/nns can shift recall a lot. also what ANN lib/version?

Maya (eng-ml): using faiss hnsw index, index config file (snippet):
```json
{"metric": "cosine", "ef_construction": 200, "M": 32, "ef_search": 64}
```
I copied this from the onboarding quickstart but prod apparently uses `ef_search: 200`.

Carlos (infra): FYI infra rolled fused-kernel runtime v2 to staging yesterday (perf patch). shouldn't change vector math but we did change BLAS fallback order. deploy-bot shows rollout at staging around the same time. :eyes:

deploy-bot: rolled runtime/fused-kernels:v2 -> staging (rollout id: rt-2026-03-16-09)

Maya (eng-ml): re-ran with `ef_search: 200` and matching index build seed; recall@10 jumps to 0.73. clustering UMAP tighter. looks like index search param mismatch was the main cause.

Ben (research): great catch. still keep an eye on runtime change but sounds like config mismatch. can you add a checkbox to the onboarding checklist to lock index/search params and seed?

Juniper (evals): also add fixed UMAP seed + sample size to the visual sanity checks so plots are reproducible in PRs. small differences cause false alarms.

Maya (eng-ml): will update onboarding PR with index-config + eval repro steps and a note about runtime/version. will also run a quick quant sweep (int8) after config parity. :thumbsup:

Carlos (infra): if you hit anything suspicious on runtime side ping infra and include reproducer command above.

Maya (eng-ml): thanks all, filing a short post with the reproducer and the fix in eng-ml.
